page.summary: Approved Calder Find Your Fit component: attached tabs over a deep navy fitment shell with vehicle selectors, restrained technical wheel artwork, dark bronze-accent CTA, and persistent selected-vehicle status.

content_max_width.value: align to established Calder primary content container; reference shell ~1904px at 2048px source
content_max_width.tolerance: do not infer a new global container token

global_layout.primary_alignment: Centered shared site container; component visually bridges hero above and light product-discovery content below.

page_background.value: context transitions from cinematic dark hero to warm off-white below

sections.name: Calder Find Your Fit / Fitment Finder

layout.desktop_structure: tabs attached above a single dark shell; shell split into finder area and selected-vehicle area
layout.shell_width_estimate: 1900px in the 2048px reference image; approximately 92-93% of viewport
layout.container_relationship: centered and aligned to the site's primary content container; do not widen the global container for this component
layout.hero_overlap: tabs/panel transition begins over the lower cinematic hero region; dark shell then bridges into light following content

spacing.negative_space: intentional around heading and technical art; not to be filled with photography

background.technical_art: low-contrast wheel line-art and contour lines
background.shadow: broad soft shadow below shell, approximately 0 18-32px 35-55px rgba(0,0,0,0.14-0.22)

components.description: Two-tab search-method navigation. By Vehicle is active; By Wheel Style is inactive. Both belong to one persistent component shell.

layout.gap: 0; tabs visually meet at angled/shared boundary

color.value: active bronze approx #D9A467; inactive cool gray approx #AAB4BC

style.background: active near-black/deep navy; inactive softened blue-navy
style.border: ~2px cool gray outer edge; bronze active bottom indicator
style.border_radius: 18-20px top corners; active lower-left integrates into panel

relationships: Tabs overlap/attach to the upper edge of the main panel.
Active tab bronze line aligns with the restrained bronze accent system.
Tab navigation remains subordinate to the hero imagery above.
implementation_guidance: ACTIVE: dark near-black surface, bronze icon/text and ~2-3px bronze lower indicator.
INACTIVE: slightly lighter navy surface, cool-gray icon/text, no bronze indicator.
HOVER: increase text/icon contrast without introducing glow or a new accent color.
FOCUS: provide a clearly visible keyboard focus ring/outline that does not rely on color alone.
Do not introduce elaborate tab animation.

components.description: Primary utility heading and supporting copy. FIT is the only heading word receiving bronze emphasis.
relationships: Heading is visually dominant within the utility but materially smaller/less cinematic than the homepage hero headline.
Supporting copy uses cool gray and wraps to two lines.
implementation_guidance: Preserve exact content hierarchy: FIND YOUR FIT, then supporting copy.
Keep bronze confined to FIT; do not turn the full heading bronze.

components.description: Low-contrast engineering artwork combining wheel line-art, contour/flow lines, and small technical details behind the finder area.

layout.content_overlap: may sit behind empty space and controls only at very low contrast

style.overlay: dark navy fade/gradient used to suppress artwork behind text and controls

imagery.opacity_estimate: roughly 8-22% depending on local line density

relationships: Artwork fills otherwise empty space to the right of heading without becoming a primary image.
Artwork fades before selected-vehicle content and remains below all interactive controls.
implementation_guidance: Treat as non-semantic decorative support.
Do not substitute a large vehicle photograph.
At narrow widths reduce, reposition, or hide artwork if needed for legibility.

components.description: Dark primary FIND WHEELS action with restrained bronze border and right arrow.

style.shadow: subtle warm edge glow only; no dominant bloom

relationships: CTA completes the selector row and is stronger than controls but not brighter than the homepage hero CTA system.
implementation_guidance: HOVER: modest bronze/contrast lift; avoid large glow.
FOCUS: obvious keyboard focus outline with sufficient contrast.
DISABLED: preserve dimensions; reduce emphasis and indicate unavailable state without removing label.

components.description: Dedicated persistent selected-vehicle context separated from the finder by a vertical divider.

typography.case: eyebrow uppercase; vehicle name title/data case

style.background: same dark shell; no separate card fill
style.border: left vertical divider ~#AAB2B5; internal horizontal separator muted #42515A

relationships: Status panel occupies roughly the rightmost 23-24% of the shell.
No vehicle photograph appears in this region.
Green is reserved for positive fitment confirmation.
Change Vehicle and Reset sit below an internal horizontal separator.
implementation_guidance: Keep selected vehicle context available when appropriate even if search method changes; technical persistence mechanism is UNKNOWN_IMPLEMENTATION_DEPENDENCY.
Change Vehicle is secondary; Reset is tertiary/secondary and separated by a vertical divider.
Do not let either secondary action compete with FIND WHEELS.

relationships: The component is a functional bridge between cinematic hero storytelling and product discovery.
It must remain visually subordinate to the hero: smaller heading scale, restrained bronze, lower-contrast imagery, no competing lifestyle photograph.
Tabs, finder content, CTA, and selected-vehicle status read as one unified utility.
The main panel transitions into light page content below, with elevation/shadow providing separation.
implementation_guidance: Preserve priority REUSE → RESTYLE → EXTEND → CREATE after auditing the existing Lumia/theme fitment functionality.
Do not replace working fitment behavior solely to match styling.
Do not widen the site's global content container to accommodate this component.
All Shopify data architecture, filtering sources, persistence storage, and app/framework choices remain implementation-agent responsibilities.

shared_components.name: Calder Find Your Fit / Fitment Finder
shared_components.reason: Explicitly designated shared premium commerce utility; fitment context can support homepage and other shopping contexts.

shared_components.name: Fitment Search Method Tabs
shared_components.reason: Two states belong to the same shared finder shell.

shared_components.name: Fitment Select Control System
shared_components.reason: Year/Make/Model/Trim and Wheel Type/Diameter/Finish/Style should use one consistent presentation system.

shared_components.name: Persistent Selected Vehicle Context
shared_components.reason: Selected vehicle state is intended to remain available across site fitment/product-discovery contexts where appropriate.

responsive_assumptions.assumption: Finder/status columns may reorganize; preserve tabs first, finder controls and CTA next, selected-vehicle context after or beside depending on available width. Avoid compressed selects.
Stack in order: tabs → Find Your Fit header → controls → Find Wheels → selected vehicle status. Controls become full/near-full width and no horizontal overflow is allowed.
Tabs remain a two-choice semantic tab control; labels may reduce typography/padding but should remain readable and touch-friendly.
At narrow widths artwork may be reduced, repositioned, or hidden to protect readability and interaction clarity.
Interactive controls and secondary actions should maintain practical touch targets of roughly 44px minimum height/target size.

implementation_notes: VISUAL_INVARIANT: premium Calder appearance using deep navy/near-black, white/cool-gray typography, restrained bronze, and green only for positive fitment confirmation.
VISUAL_INVARIANT: FIND YOUR FIT remains the component title; FIT alone receives restrained bronze emphasis.
VISUAL_INVARIANT: By Vehicle / By Wheel Style are states of one component, not unrelated components.
VISUAL_INVARIANT: consistent dark select-control system and dark bronze-accent FIND WHEELS CTA across both tabs.
VISUAL_INVARIANT: subtle technical wheel/engineering artwork remains background support and never becomes a primary image.
VISUAL_INVARIANT: dedicated selected-vehicle context with fitment confirmation, Change Vehicle, and Reset; no redundant car photograph.
VISUAL_INVARIANT: component remains visually subordinate to the homepage hero.
BY_VEHICLE: Year → Make → Model → Trim is a dependent selection sequence; implementation mechanism is not prescribed.
BY_WHEEL_STYLE: preserve shell/header/art/control/CTA/status styling; controls conceptually become Wheel Type, Diameter, Finish, Style. Exact option lists are not production taxonomy.

UNKNOWN_IMPLEMENTATION_DEPENDENCY: authoritative data source for Wheel Type (product option, variant, metafield, metaobject, tag, collection filter, Search & Discovery filter, Lumia filter, or custom data) must be audited.
UNKNOWN_IMPLEMENTATION_DEPENDENCY: authoritative data source for Diameter must be audited.
UNKNOWN_IMPLEMENTATION_DEPENDENCY: authoritative data source for Finish must be audited.
UNKNOWN_IMPLEMENTATION_DEPENDENCY: authoritative data source for Style must be audited.
UNKNOWN_IMPLEMENTATION_DEPENDENCY: existing vehicle-fitment provider/data flow and Year/Make/Model/Trim dependency mechanism must be audited.
UNKNOWN_IMPLEMENTATION_DEPENDENCY: persistence mechanism for selected vehicle / 'Fitment enabled across the site' must be audited.
UNKNOWN_IMPLEMENTATION_DEPENDENCY: Change Vehicle behavior must be mapped to existing Lumia/custom workflow before alteration.
UNKNOWN_IMPLEMENTATION_DEPENDENCY: Reset behavior and scope must be verified before alteration.
UNKNOWN_IMPLEMENTATION_DEPENDENCY: current section/snippet architecture, JavaScript framework, app integrations, and storage mechanism must be audited by OpenCode/DeepSeek.
INTERACTION: semantic tab state, visible keyboard focus, persistent form labels, adequate contrast, disabled/loading states, hover states, selected states, and error states are required.
INTERACTION: FIND WHEELS remains primary; Change Vehicle and Reset remain secondary.
OPTIONAL_ELEMENT: decorative technical background artwork may be reduced/hidden responsively but should be present on desktop when asset/implementation allows.
CONDITIONAL_ELEMENT: selected-vehicle content is populated only when a vehicle context exists; empty/no-vehicle behavior must preserve the shell hierarchy without fabricated vehicle data.
IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_VERIFICATION: audit existing equivalent first and classify each requirement REUSE, RESTYLE, EXTEND, or CREATE in that priority order.
IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_VERIFICATION: preserve known-working Shopify/theme functionality and data bindings wherever practical.
IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_VERIFICATION: verify actual store taxonomy/data before populating By Wheel Style options; do not hard-code conceptual examples as final Calder taxonomy.
